# safegit reset

reset HEAD with guards that prevent accidental --hard data loss. The worktree operation lock is taken for EVERY reset, because every reset moves HEAD; the uncommitted-work check applies to --hard alone, since only --hard mutates the working tree

**Effect:** mutating
